name: How do I know if my kitchen faucet needs to be replaced?

mainEntity.name: How do I know if my kitchen faucet needs to be replaced?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common signs indicating your kitchen faucet needs replacement include persistent leaks that can't be easily repaired, visible corrosion or rust, reduced water pressure from the faucet itself, and difficulty operating the handles. If your faucet is old, making strange noises, or has become aesthetically unappealing, replacement can also be a good option. Addressing these issues promptly can prevent further damage to your sink area and cabinetry. A professional plumber can assess the condition of your existing faucet and recommend the best course of action.
acceptedAnswer.description: Look for leaks, corrosion, low water pressure, or difficulty operating the handles. An old or noisy faucet may also need replacement.
